Customer Service Representative Job at PalmPay




        
    

        
        PALMPAY is a Pan-African fintech company currently operating in Nigeria, Ghana and Kenya and expanding to other markets in 2022. We’re reinventing the payments experience by making it easy and reliable for everyone to transfer money, pay bills and shop online.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Representative 

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Contract

Responsibilities
Customer Support via Inbound Channel:
     

            
    




	Respond to customer inquiries through call platforms.
	Provide information about products, services, policies, and procedures.
	Assist customers with orders, payments, or account issues.


Problem Resolution:


	Identify customer problems and provide solutions.
	Troubleshoot technical or service issues.
	Escalate complex cases to supervisors or specialized teams when necessary.


Multitasking:


	Handle call conversations effectively.
	Navigate different systems (CRM, knowledge base, order system) while on call.


Documentation:


	Record customer interactions in the system.
	Update customer records and case notes accurately.


Customer Experience:


	Maintain a professional, polite, and friendly tone.
	Ensure quick response time and high satisfaction levels.
	Follow company communication guidelines and scripts.


Product/Service Knowledge:


	Stay updated on company products, promotions, and policies.
	Use internal knowledge bases to provide accurate answers.


Performance Targets


	Meet KPIs such as:
	
		Average handling time
		Customer satisfaction (CSAT)
		Resolution time
		Average talk time.
	
	


Salary
Basic - N70,000 monthly, KPI - (N20,000 - N100,000)

	Our client is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Business Development Manager (Development Sector) to drive its growth and revenue within the development sector by identifying, securing, and expanding strategic business opportunities.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading the agency&#39;s institutional business development function, including market intelligence, donor engagement, partnership development, competitive bidding, proposal management, commercial negotiations, and client growth.

	Coordinate cross-functional proposal teams to produce high-quality, compliant, and competitive submissions.
	Oversee proposal strategy, quality assurance, pricing coordination, and submission planning.
	Maintain proposal templates, capability statements, organisational profiles, and proposal knowledge assets.
	Build and manage strategic relationships with institutional clients, donor agencies, development partners, and key stakeholders.
	Represent JT Agency at industry engagements, donor meetings, conferences, and networking events.
	Lead client acquisition initiatives while strengthening long-term partnerships that generate repeat business and framework agreements.
	Lead commercial negotiations and support the development of competitive, profitable commercial proposals.

	Support contract implementation through renewals, amendments, extensions, and ongoing commercial relationship management.

	Strong analytical, research, project coordination, and organisational abilities.

Remuneration
N7,200,000 - N9,600,000 Net Annually.
